Nina had spent three evenings designing a poster for the school concert. On Monday morning, she hurried to the noticeboard, hoping to see it beside the main entrance. The poster was missing.

She immediately suspected Leo, who had argued that the concert needed a different design. Nina avoided him throughout the morning. At lunchtime, their teacher asked why she looked upset. After listening, the teacher opened a cupboard and showed Nina the poster.
